prompt: Who starred in a movie about the subject of a song on the compilation album "Friends and Relatives," and also played themselves on an episode of "Friends"?
answer: The actor was **Jean-Claude Van Damme**. He starred in *Timecop*, a film about time—the subject of Yes’s song **“Time and a Word”** on *Friends and Relatives*—and appeared as himself in the *Friends* episode “The One After the Super Bowl: Part 2.”
